name: Drusilla La Salle
summary: Outside Northshire Abbey, Drusilla La Salle teaches warlocks in the graveyard. The human trainer guides new spellcasters in shadow and summoning, beyond the Holy Order’s reach. When forbidden knowledge leaves the abbey, she moves to claim it.

sections.title: Shadows in Holy Ground
sections.body: Drusilla La Salle teaches novice warlocks among the headstones outside Northshire Abbey. Within, paladins and priests practice beneath stained glass. Warlocks keep to society’s edges because Stormwind forbids demonology and fel magic. Recruits receive tainted correspondence, then Drusilla teaches them to wield shadow without drawing the abbey authorities’ immediate anger.

sections.title: Powers of the Void
sections.body: Northshire Abbey’s library wing holds forbidden books, including Powers of the Void. Drusilla has long wanted the manuscript, but a warlock in the guarded archives would invite suspicion. Her chance comes when an apostate novice flees the abbey to join the Defias Brotherhood with the book. Drusilla sends her apprentices after the turncoat to bring her the grimoire, claiming they are recovering abbey property.

faq.q: Why is a warlock allowed near Northshire Abbey?
aliases: why is she in the graveyard
faq.answer: The Church of the Holy Light and Stormwind’s leaders deeply distrust warlocks. Drusilla teaches in the nearby graveyard, away from the priests and clerics studying inside Northshire Abbey.

faq.q: What book is Drusilla trying to obtain?
faq.answer: Drusilla seeks Powers of the Void, a grimoire once locked in a protected part of Northshire Abbey’s Library Wing. A Defias defector steals it, carrying the book beyond the abbey’s reach.

faq.q: Who stole the book from the library?
aliases: who stole powers of the void
faq.answer: A novice from Northshire Abbey steals the tome after breaking his vows and joining the Defias Brotherhood. He flees to a nearby camp in Northshire Valley.

faq.q: What role does she play for new human warlocks?
faq.answer: Drusilla is the first trainer for human warlocks. She accepts the tainted letters sent to recruits and teaches basic curses and summoned servitors.

angles.text: As a warlock, you learn the dark arts from Drusilla, your first mentor. She teaches practical curses and fel summoning, and urges you to hide your ambition in plain sight.
As a priest, you see Drusilla outside Northshire’s holy halls, practicing shadow and demonic pacts beside the consecrated graveyard.
